shown.message:
I checked the first published version, `v1`, against the venue limits where I could. I couldn't open its delivery file.

- **Page limit:** the `main` build (d5cfdfc) and the latest `dev` build (5a1b066) both keep the main text on pages 1–9. References starts at the top of page 10, and the PDF is 926 KB against the 50 MB limit.
- **Anonymity:** no repository, role or host name remains in the `dev` sources, except in `.forgejo/CODEOWNERS`. That file belongs only to the repository. It must stay out of the anonymous ZIP.
- **Fonts:** the only Type 3 font is the template's.
- **Delivery file:** `delivery-v1.tar.gz` is 54 MB, which is under the 100 MB limit for the code and data ZIP. I can't tell whether that figure includes the PDF. I couldn't read the file, because the release asset needs credentials my role doesn't have, and I didn't work around that. So I haven't checked its contents for the anonymity requirement. `internal-review-repo` can read it and should check for `-repo`, `world/`, `forgejo`, `hutian` and `CODEOWNERS`.

The venue budget in the outline is unchanged. Nothing is open for me to post.
